description: The $MERCA a wallet has locked in the factor registry, how much counts for its tier (locked, no unlock requested) and when a requested unlock is ready. A wallet balance never counts. Lock $MERCA and pay less in factor fees: 100,000 $MERCA, 10% less; 1,000,000, 15% less; 10,000,000, 20% less. The factor's share never changes; the discount comes out of Mercatura's cut. Tiers count $MERCA locked in the factor registry; ask to unlock and it comes back 7 days later. These are the launch numbers; Mercatura can change them.
name: merca_lock_status
title: $MERCA: what a wallet has locked
